name: QiYi Speed Void Cube 3x3 (Magnetic + UV)
description: The QiYi Speed Void Cube (Magnetic + UV) is a unique twist on the classic 3x3 puzzle – literally! Unlike a standard 3x3 Cube, the Void Cube has no centerpieces, creating a hollow, ring-like appearance that’s both visually striking and mechanically intriguing.
